ID Card vs Driver License: Which to Use as ID

Both prove identity, neither proves the same thing, and the choice changes what a seller can charge and what a checker can test. Here is where each one actually works.

An identity card is issued purely to prove identity. It carries no entitlement, no vehicle class and no test history. That narrow purpose is exactly why it is the easiest document in this market to fake well.

A driver licence proves identity and entitlement at once. It carries a category grid, which is the hardest part to typeset, and a number that follows a constructed rule in most countries. It is harder to fake and easier to test.

So the trade is simple. An ID card is cheaper and looks convincing and offers almost nothing to test. A licence costs more and gives you the number, the grid and the address to work with.

Prices track that. Identity cards sit at ninety to five hundred dollars in observed adverts. Licences sit at one hundred and twenty to six hundred and fifty, and the overlap is small at the top where a real number is in play.

Use an identity card when the only requirement is a photo and a name across a counter. Use a licence when somebody will look at the card properly, because the grid and the number give them something to catch.

The tests on an ID card are the number algorithm, the UV layer and the chip where one exists. In countries with a check digit, the number is the whole game, and a seller who invents numbers will fail it immediately.

The tests on a licence are the number, the category grid, the ghost image, the microprint and the address consistency. That is five tests rather than three, which is why the licence is the better buy for the same money.

One trap: some countries issue a provisional licence that looks like an identity card and carries no full entitlement. Sellers blur it into the licence category and price it as one. Check the provisional marking on the face.

Quick answers

Another trap is the age card. Several countries issue a card whose only function is to prove age for alcohol. It is not an identity document in the full sense and it will not satisfy a bank or a landlord.

If you need identity for a counter, buy neither and use the passport you already have. These documents are for when the passport is not appropriate, and that is a narrower need than most adverts suggest.

Is a licence better than an ID card?

For inspection resistance, yes. It has more testable features and a constructed number.

Can an ID card be used abroad?

Rarely. Outside the issuing country most are secondary evidence at best.

What is the cheapest useful document?

A licence with a valid number format. The ID card is cheaper but leaves you nothing to test.

Put it to use

Pick a document and a country, then run the checks in order.
